responsibility: Provides the core construction, mutation, verification, and utility logic for GCC’s tree/GIMPLE control-flow graph. It initializes empty function CFGs, builds basic blocks and edges from GIMPLE, manages special cases such as switch edge-to-case mappings, abnormal and EH-related control flow, block merging/splitting and edge redirection, CFG dumping/verification helpers, and assorted region and loop-oriented CFG services that other tree passes rely on when editing or validating GIMPLE CFGs.
same_name_distinction: Contains the executable logic for the tree/GIMPLE CFG subsystem declared in tree-cfg.h, including CFG creation from GIMPLE, edge/block mutation, verification, switch-edge bookkeeping, and related selftests.
